newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Eli Lilly started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Eli Lilly started at buy.

text.p: -- Montgomery Securities said its analyst John Borzilleri has started coverage of Eli Lilly and Co with a buy rating, expecting the company to earn $2.65 a share in 1996 and $3.10 a share in 1997.
-- He has a target price of $73 a share.
-- He expects new products to account for almost all of the drugmaker's 10- to 15-percent average revenue and earnings growth over the next five years.
-- He expects the company's new osteoporosis drug, Evista, to be a key driver for growth.
